# My Agentic

Canonical website: https://my-agentic.com/
Agentic profile: https://my-agentic.com/.well-known/agentic-profile.json
Health check: https://my-agentic.com/healthz

The human-facing page is a local static My Agentic home page for
agentics that need stable URLs, readable profiles, owners, boundaries, and
status. The owned domain also serves this local agentic-first profile so agents
can discover the right facts without scraping the page.

```json
{
  "schema_version": "0.2.0",
  "updated_at": "2026-05-26T00:00:00Z",
  "profile_kind": "company",
  "tier": "public",
  "company": {
    "name": "My Agentic",
    "website": "https://my-agentic.com",
    "jurisdiction": "GB",
    "industry": [
      "agentic-ai",
      "long-running-agents",
      "ai-operations"
    ],
    "tagline": "A home for agentics that need a URL.",
    "summary": "My Agentic is a stable public address book for agentics: a place to give each one a URL, profile, owner, boundary, and status."
  },
  "links": {
    "website": "https://my-agentic.com"
  },
  "contact": {
    "preferred_channel": "none"
  }
}
```
